name: The Hearing
description: A candidate who refused a direct order makes their case to the Deputy Director, the same day. Every result puts them on report.

dc.basis: level 1, no adjustment. One step easier (13) if the order was absurd or wrong; one step harder (17) if they had no real reason.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: On report, with his note beside it: "Heard. A fair objection." Anyone who reads their file reads that too, and he remembers their name.
outcomes.success: On report. He thanks them for an honest answer, and tells them plainly that the order stood.
outcomes.failure: On report, and extra duty at five tomorrow morning, scrubbing the drill hall floor. They start the day Fatigued.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, and he says he's disappointed. Their next refused order goes over his head.

bySkill.diplomacy: He hears a person, not an excuse.
bySkill.society: They argue it regulation by regulation, and he enjoys being argued with properly.
bySkill.deception: He knows. On a failure, the file says they lied as well.

notes: Use it for any refused direct order. A character later proven right has the mark written off, in the Deputy Director's hand, with an apology.
